title: Network diagnostics
tips: Confirm link status (ifconfig / media) before assuming DHCP failure.
Compare ping to gateway vs a public IP to separate LAN vs WAN problems.
VPN clients often steal the default route — inspect utun interfaces.
Renew DHCP with `sudo ipconfig set en0 DHCP` after confirming physical link.
nslookup failure with working ping to 8.8.8.8 points to DNS, not routing.
